title: The Elite vs. the Inner Circle
summary: AEW’s early faction rivalry grows from the first Dynamite into the stadium-spanning fight at Double or Nothing.

chapters.title: A faction takes shape
chapters.result: Jericho’s allies attack the Elite after the main event.
